long_biography.plain_text:
At Six Senses Ibiza, Jonathan Leitersdorf brought architecture, property development and hospitality together on the cliffs above Xarraca Bay. He conceived and developed the resort around the contours of the coast, using local materials and references to traditional Ibizan buildings. Rooms built into the cliffs and communal spaces made the setting central to the design.

His plans extended beyond accommodation. Working with hospitality specialist Ben Pundole and his partners, he helped create The Beach Caves, bringing dining, music and entertainment into the resort. The project expressed his interest in places where guests could gather as well as retreat. Having opened in 2021, the hotel was sold to Italy's Statuto group in 2024.
